'''Ursellis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as an [[Imperial Prefect]]. After Ursellis developed a penchant for issuing large numbers of [[Legal Authorization for Advanced Confinement Document]]s in order to deal with her enemies, her assistant [[Sub-Prefect]] [[Matagorn]] became overburdened with a heavy workload. Matagorn was subsequently [[Death/Legends|murdered]] by the [[Srrors'tok]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Tyionsis Cex]] after incurring the ire of the [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]], and Ursellis was unconcerned by his loss.
